details:
The main objective of our project is to understand how fire behaves in microgravity and help improve fire-safety knowledge for future space missions.

Our website provides several features, including a dashboard, experiment explorer, flame lab, mission lab, AI fire-safety assistant and research insights.

Users can explore experiments, understand flame behaviour, compare research findings and learn about possible fire hazards in space.

The website uses modern web technologies and data analysis to make complex scientific research easier to understand. Website uses combines modern frontend development, 3D graphics, scientific data analysis, interactive dashboards, and AI-assisted research.

In conclusion, Flame in Freefall aims to support safer space exploration by helping people understand fire behaviour in microgravity
